title.narrative: Establishing a One Health Approach in Libya

description.narrative:
This proposal aims to contribute to the achievement of a resilient health system in Libya by continuing to advocate for Universal Health Coverage (UHC), while also laying a strong foundation for the development of a Libyan One Health Approach (a way of working that addresses animal, human and environmental health as a whole through an integrated, unifying approach that aims to sustainably balance and optimize the health of people, animals and ecosystems. The One Health approach is the essential foundation of a truly resilient and secure health system).

Overall objective: Contribute to achieving a resilient health system for Libya

Specific objectives:

Specific objective 1 ¿ To advance progress towards achieving UHC in Libya

Specific objective 2 ¿ To improve the performance of the surveillance system, including zoonotic diseases

Specific objective 3 ¿ To launch the One Health Approach in Libya
